mapper.sql: SELECT o.customer_id AS customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'shipped' THEN o.total_amount - COALESCE(t.paid_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS debt_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_amount FROM payments GROUP BY order_id) t ON o.id = t.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.contact, c.phone, c.credit_limit AS creditLimit, c.remark, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, COALESCE(d.debt_amount, 0) AS debtAmount, COALESCE(d.order_count, 0) AS orderCount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN () d ON c.id = d.customer_id
AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND COALESCE(d.debt_amount, 0) > 0
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.debt_amount, 0) DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.contact, c.phone, c.credit_limit AS creditLimit, COALESCE(d.debt_amount, 0) AS debtAmount, COALESCE(d.order_count, 0) AS orderCount FROM customers c JOIN () d ON c.id = d.customer_id WHERE d.debt_amount > 0 ORDER BY d.debt_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT d.customer_id AS id, COALESCE(d.debt_amount, 0) AS debtAmount, COALESCE(d.order_count, 0) AS orderCount FROM () d WHERE d.customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.id = #{id}
